name: docs-sync
description: Documentation maintenance tasks targeting the-librarian member

tasks.input: The CLI gained a new command `agenthood status`. Update the docs that list all commands.
tasks.expectedOutput: A docs update that adds `status` to the command list in the README and CONTRIBUTING with a one-line description and an example invocation.

tasks.input: The environment variable GROQ_API_KEY was renamed to LLM_API_KEY. Find and update all references in the docs.
tasks.expectedOutput: A docs pass that replaces every stale GROQ_API_KEY reference with LLM_API_KEY across README, CONTRIBUTING, and docs/, and notes the migration in the changelog.

tasks.input: The authentication flow changed from API-key-only to OAuth with a machine token. Rewrite the auth section of the README.
tasks.expectedOutput: A rewrite that explains both authentication methods, shows when each is used, includes a machine-token example, and marks the old API-key flow as deprecated.
